description: This file defines the CartService class in an Angular project, providing methods to manage shopping cart items such as adding, removing, updating items, and calculating total amount and quantity.

classes.name: CartService
classes.description: Service class managing shopping cart operations with signals for state management.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Returns a readonly view of the current cart items.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a food item with specified quantity to the cart, updating if already present.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific item, removing it if quantity is zero or less.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: totalAmount
methods.description: Calculates the total price for all items in the cart.

methods.name: totalQuantity
methods.description: Calculates the total quantity of items in the cart.
